title: Cross-environment staged containment and KV-cache reconciliation for production regressions
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Root problem: an increasingly common pattern where a model variant rollout causes divergent KV-cache fingerprints across environments (hosted vs dedicated vs private) and leads to silent quality regressions for a small set of customer accounts. This ticket scopes the staged containment flow plus a reconciler to realign KV cache state and routing metadata during live rollbacks. Goals: avoid broad rollbacks that disrupt unaffected customers, provide deterministic steps to rehydrate/flush caches consistently, and deliver a customer-facing escalation script and automated telemetry checks to detect stale cache divergence early.
acceptance_criteria: A containment flow that isolates affected account groups without flipping global feature gates has been documented and tested in staging.
A KV-cache reconciliation job exists that can compute per-account cache diffs and apply rehydrate/flush operations safely in low-risk windows.
Automated Canary alarms trigger when per-account prediction distributions diverge by configured thresholds and surface suggested remediation steps in the console.
A one-button rollback + cache-reconcile play is available for on-call with a clear checklist and automated diagnostics attached to the incident Slack thread.
Customer communication templates and internal escalation ladder are reviewed and approved by PM and SRE.
Unit and integration tests cover reconciliation idempotency and do-not-affect-unrelated-caches behavior.
tasks: [ ] Draft containment topology: per-region + per-customer-account routing slices
[ ] Implement kvcache-reconciler prototype (dry-run mode) and add verbose logging
[ ] Add reconciliation API for customer ops to rehydrate/flush single-account caches
[ ] Wire canary divergence metric into console: distribution-comparison panel and alert rule
[ ] Create rollback orchestration script that pairs feature-flag flip with cache-recon job
[ ] Run 3 simulated incidents in staging using production-like traces and validate no collateral impact
[ ] Draft customer-facing escalation email and in-product notice templates
[ ] Postmortem and playbook entry: update on-call runbook and run two training drills

runbook_steps: 1) Triage: identify affected model variant and customer account(s) using console sample-labelling panel
2) Contain: isolate traffic for affected account(s) to recovery pool via routing policy (route->recovery-pool)
3) Dry-run reconcile: execute kvcache-reconciler --dry-run --accounts <list> and review diff report
4) Approve: if diffs are small and shard pressure low, schedule live reconcile during low-traffic window
5) Execute: kvcache-reconciler --apply --accounts <list> with progress tracing and circuit-breaker monitoring
6) Validate: run canary requests and evaluate distribution diff panels; if stable, reintroduce normal routing
7) Rollback fallback: if reconciliation causes regressions, execute feature-flag rollback script and rehydrate from snapshot, then engage hotfix lane
8) Communicate: send templated status update to affected customers and attach reconciliation report
